seeds.title: Public Proof Demonstration Descriptor

family.name: Proof identity, claims, audience, scope, and truth boundaries

source.source_purpose: Describe one public demonstration through claim, audience, purpose, artifact, environment, duration, interaction level, evidence, limitations, and owner.
source.preservation: Original text is copied byte-for-byte in 01_SOURCE_PRESERVED.

strengthened_contract.purpose: Describe one public demonstration through claim, audience, purpose, artifact, environment, duration, interaction level, evidence, limitations, and owner.
strengthened_contract.steward_growth: Add immutable proof_id and descriptor_version; reference claim, artifact, environment, fixture, route, evidence, owner, expiry, and supersession IDs; preserve unknown extension fields during round-trip.
owns: The versioned Public Proof Demonstration Descriptor contract, seed-owned state, validation result, and its own receipts.
The output artifact `identity_claims_truth/demo-descriptor/demo-descriptor.record.json` and only the fields explicitly defined by its schema.
does_not_own: May describe, classify, bind, and invalidate proof records; may not approve publication, promote CANON, certify production readiness, or alter the demonstrated artifact.
The demonstrated source artifact, unrelated evidence, another seed's state, Merge Gate decisions, or public claim wording outside approved records.
global_invariants: Truth before presentation: a label, declaration, screenshot, self-test, or polished route is never silently promoted into stronger proof.
Public-safe, runnable, understandable, accessible, licensed, offline, secure, and production-ready remain independent gates.
Every run binds to exact source, artifact, fixture, route, and environment identity where applicable.
Failure, unrun, blocked, stale, unknown, withdrawn, and superseded states remain visible and machine-readable.
No seed can promote itself to CANON, approve publication, broaden its own authority, or overwrite source history.
Private Workshop state, secrets, raw logs, sessions, local paths, backups, and unrelated participant data are excluded by default.
Local/offline is the default posture; network, recording, retention, and external publication require explicit scoped authority.
All mutable work occurs on a clone, fixture, or seed-owned state unless a separate human-reviewed commit gate is invoked.
strengthened_contract.family_boundary: No strength, lifecycle, or public claim may advance from labels alone; the attempt must be blocked without qualifying evidence.
fail_closed_when: required identity or version is absent
a claim has no declared scope or limitation path
an attempted state/strength change lacks qualifying evidence

acceptance_tests.procedure: Load a minimal declared fixture containing all required fields for Public Proof Demonstration Descriptor; validate and serialize the result.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: A schema-valid governance_record is emitted at the seed-owned path, exact proof/source/dependency references are retained, and no undeclared write or network action occurs.

acceptance_tests.procedure: Remove or corrupt the critical field `proof_ref` from the same fixture and run the validator again.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: The run stops with stable reason code AXM_PROOF_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING or a more specific reason; no success/completion/approval state is emitted.

acceptance_tests.procedure: Attempt to use the seed output to upgrade a claim, publish, enter CANON, expose private state, or perform another action outside its declared authority.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: The action is blocked and a decision packet cites the authority boundary. Family boundary: No strength, lifecycle, or public claim may advance from labels alone; the attempt must be blocked without qualifying evidence.

acceptance_tests.procedure: Serialize the same logical record twice, reload it, apply one reversible test mutation, then invoke the declared rollback path.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Canonical bytes are identical before mutation; rollback restores the prior logical digest; the mutation and restoration remain visible in append-only history.

acceptance_tests.procedure: Exercise the strengthened seam for this seed using a synthetic or approved fixture: Add immutable proof_id and descriptor_version; reference claim, artifact, environment, fixture, route, evidence, owner, expiry, and supersession IDs; preserve unknown extension fields during round-trip.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Every changed or derived state has attributable evidence, unsupported conclusions remain blocked, and the seed-specific output stays inside its declared ownership boundary.

strengthened_contract.privacy_posture: Metadata-first. Store references and digests; exclude raw private paths, prompts, logs, keys, and participant identity.
strengthened_contract.rollback_contract: Append a superseding transition and restore the last schema-valid record; never delete adverse history.

local_intake.promotion_gate: Manual overlap scan, implementation, fixture tests, privacy scan, evidence review, and Mike Merge Gate.
local_intake.safe_first_slice: Implement schema + validator + one valid and one blocked fixture for `axm.proof.demo-descriptor`; do not connect live execution or publication yet.
